recent_posts.title: How generational differences affect consumer attitudes towards ads
recent_posts.summary: Meta Research found generational differences affect consumer attitudes towards ads. The focus of ads has moved from product and services to putting people at the heart of a campaign. For GenZ, consenting to data use is the ‘new normal’ and navigating the online world is the norm.

recent_posts.title: Every tree counts: Large-scale mapping of canopy height at the resolution of individual trees
recent_posts.summary: Meta Research is developing new technology solutions to mitigate our own carbon footprint. Forests play a central role in the carbon dioxide cycle, pulling carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and storing the carbon in their biomass. In 2020, Meta set a goal to reach net zero emissions across our value chain in 2030.

recent_posts.title: How a non-traditional background led to cutting-edge XR tech
recent_posts.summary: Isabel, a data scientist and self-described ‘diplomat kid,’ was born in seven countries across Europe and Asia by the time she was 18. Her early interest in ‘what makes people tick’ propelled her along a non-traditional path — to Meta and in life.

recent_posts.title: A new, unique AI dataset for animating amateur drawings
recent_posts.summary: A new, unique AI dataset for animating amateur drawings April 13, 2023 is released. It includes a novel dataset of nearly 180,000 annotated amateur drawings. This is the first annotated dataset to feature this kind of artwork. With the new dataset, researchers and practitioners can build tools to more easily and accurately analyze the contents.

recent_posts.title: Announcing the 2023 Meta Research PhD Fellowship award winners
recent_posts.summary: Meta Research Fellowship has supported more than 200 PhD candidates from around the world. Fellows receive full coverage of tuition and university fees for up to two academic years, as well as a $42,000 stipend. This year, we received over 3,200 applications from over 100 universities worldwide and selected 21 outstanding Fellows.

recent_posts.title: Announcing the winners of the 2022 Foundational Integrity Research RFP
recent_posts.summary: Meta's integrity efforts are at the heart of the company’s mission to give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. The RFP attracted 503 proposals from 349 universities and institutions around the world. The winners are listed first unless otherwise noted.

recent_posts.title: Postponed: 2022 Meta Research Testing and Verification Symposium
recent_posts.summary: The next TAV Symposium will now take place the week of March 6, 2023. Postponed this year’s event will allow us to bring together researchers from across academia and industry for the first time since 2019. Colocated with TAV 2023 will be a Simulation-Based Analysis and Testing (SIMBAT) Workshop.

recent_posts.title: EgoObjects: A large-scale egocentric dataset for object understanding
recent_posts.summary: EgoObjects: A large-scale egocentric dataset for object understanding is a fundamental research topic in the computer vision community. We’ll present benchmarking results on two tasks, including the traditional object category-level detection and a novel object instance- level detection. In doing those, we hope to share insights.

recent_posts.title: Four Analytics Best Practices We Adopted — and Why You should Too
recent_posts.summary: Four Analytics Best Practices We Adopted - and Why You should Too: Data-driven decisions are everywhere. Data is the foundation upon which Meta strives to provide the most valuable and safe product experience. We hope to demonstrate how they’ve helped us make more trustworthy and efficient decisions based on data.

recent_posts.title: Introducing LLaMA: A foundational, 65-billion-parameter language model
recent_posts.summary: LLaMA (Large Language Model Meta AI) is a state-of-the-art foundational large language model designed to help researchers advance their work in this subfield of AI. It requires far less computing power and resources to test new approaches, validate others’ work, and explore new use cases.

top_posts.title: Meta Research PhD Fellowship Spotlight: Making the most of data with meta-learning
top_posts.summary: Misha Khodak is a PhD student in computer science at Carnegie Mellon University. His research is centered on foundations and applications of machine learning. He also works on related areas such as neural architecture search, federated learning, and algorithms with predictions. Each year, PhD students from around the world apply for the Meta PhD Fellowship.

top_posts.title: Announcing the winners of the 2022 Meta AR/VR Policy Research request for proposals for the Asia Pacific region
top_posts.summary: In June, Meta launched the 2022 Meta AR/VR Policy Research request for proposals for the Asia Pacific region. The awards are funded by the Meta XR Programs and Research Fund, a two-year, $50 million investment in programs and external research to help in the effort of building the metaverse responsibly.
